Entries.Original: Good, you're all here. Today, we will need you on an escort mission to an experimental farm near the Kumagaya Dome.
That is where we planted grechka plant.
Correct. Owing to your contributions, the experimental farm has begun providing food to nearby bases and domes.
Now that its arable land has proven practical, the place requires protection, just as the domes do.
You mean defending with a wall made of Cancer shells?
Indeed. However, it has been confirmed that the sound and vibration of the construction work have drawn Cancer's attention to the area.
As such, we will need you to serve as escorts for the transport trucks delivering supplies and the engineers working on the wall.
This sounds like a very important mission.
Hmph, an escort mission? Send me to kill Cancers that put up a fight.
Maria, don't lash out at the mission. We can eat some pizza when we come back.
I am actually going to kill you.
What do you mean "actually"?! Am I actually about to get killed?!
To stay on topic, I will say the construction work could very well draw out powerful Cancers, so do stay vigilant.
